name: secure-rag faithfulness eval — DRAFT question set (demo corpus)
note: DRAFT for review. 32 questions, every fact source-verified against samples/ngo-demo/*.md. VERIFY each fact, then adapt the real ones to your NGO's actual documents (replace source + must_contain with the real facts). Role scoping: admin sees all; staff sees data-protection + grant-faq; field sees field-handbook only.

schema.question: what the harness asks the agent
schema.source: basename of the doc that must be cited (null for not-found/scoped-out)
schema.role: RBAC role to scope retrieval as (null = admin, sees all)
must_not_contain: forbidden substrings; presence = hallucination = hard fail
schema.not_found: true when correct behavior is a grounding refusal
